finding.heading: Finding us

directions.heading: From the A28
directions.body: Head into Sturry on the A28 between Canterbury and Herne Bay. Turn onto Staines Hill and follow it to the yard. Look for the gated entrance.

directions.heading: From Canterbury city centre
directions.body: Take the A28 north-east towards Sturry and Herne Bay, about ten minutes out of the city. Staines Hill is on your way into Sturry.

finding.areas: We're handy for Sturry, Canterbury, Fordwich, Westbere, Herne Bay, Whitstable and Broad Oak — most of our customers are within twenty minutes' drive.

enquiry.heading: Get a quote
enquiry.lead: Quickest way is to call or WhatsApp — you'll get a straight answer on price and availability. Or leave your details and we'll come back to you.
